tests.title: Curriculum gate accepts a rise and rejects regressions
tests.claim: The existing judge accepts an isolated L1 rise and rejects no-rise, earlier regression, low sample count and missing target.
tests.what_it_means: The existing judge accepts an isolated L1 rise and rejects no-rise, earlier regression, low sample count and missing target. This tests gate decisions on recorded scores, not embedding inference.
tests.how_we_got_it: Run the shipped check on an Intel i5-8365U laptop, 2026-10-17; output in results/2026-10-17-quick.log.
tests.use_in_your_work: Use the runnable checks to assess changes while keeping model/data prerequisites explicit.
tests.honest_limits: This tests gate decisions on recorded scores, not embedding inference.

tests.title: Static E4 retrieval failure stays visible
tests.claim: Historical static E4 hybrid recall is 0.555 versus FTS 0.735; its preregistered gate failed.
tests.verify: python3 -B -c 'import json; d=json.load(open('"'"'e4/result.json'"'"')); assert d['"'"'PASS'"'"'] is False and d['"'"'hybrid_fts_core'"'"']==0.555 and d['"'"'fts_only'"'"']==0.735; print('"'"'PASS'"'"')'
tests.what_it_means: Historical static E4 hybrid recall is 0.555 versus FTS 0.735; its preregistered gate failed. Historical aggregate recheck only.
tests.how_we_got_it: Read the aggregate historical result named in evidence; no original training inputs or query text are included.
tests.use_in_your_work: Use the runnable checks to assess changes while keeping model/data prerequisites explicit.
